_doc: Section, anchor, picture, on-screen text and asset type per shot, from the brief's shot list (rev 54). Regenerate with scripts/shot_descriptions.py.

D01.picture: The real research chat scrolling to the first numbers (section 5)

D02.picture: Dim garage. Masked sock puppets around a table, a vault blueprint under a swinging lamp

D03.picture: Pull back from one lanyard to a corkboard of thousands

D04.picture: The leader holds up a card that says PLEASE

D04a.picture: A puppet slaps black bars over every lanyard number on the corkboard

D04b.picture: The cut-paper title slams in on the downbeat with a horn stab

D04c.picture: Four-way split-screen roll call: four identical masked puppets, each freeze-framed with a typed role
D04c.text: THE PROXY / THE BURNER / THE PROMPTER / THE BOTTLER

D04d.picture: The vault at night: brass gleaming, the teller window lit, a sign reading OPEN

D04e.picture: The proxy van pulls out of the garage, headlights sweeping the wall; hands off to D05's four-way van split

D05.picture: Four-way split screen: the same van parks in four unidentifiable streets, different plates each time

D06.picture: A puppet flips its lanyard to a new number

D07.picture: One credit card passed hand to hand down the line; an old telephone switchboard, patch cords hopping socket to socket

D08.picture: Crash zoom into the switchboard's tangle of cords

D09.picture: A puppet puts a stethoscope to the vault, shrugs, and walks to the teller window instead

D10.picture: A line of puppets out the door and around the block, each taking a numbered ticket

D11.picture: The teller prints yards of ticker tape; puppets haul it in hand over hand

D12.picture: The tape feeds a copper still; amber drips into bottles labeled REASONING, SMALL BATCH

D13.picture: A brass arm tosses a puppet out the door; it's back in line at once, number one higher

D14.picture: Puppet shadows on a wall form a hydra; one head drops, two rise

D15.picture: Full shot of the still, crew dancing around it

D16.picture: Glowing liquid through a kitchen sieve

D17.picture: A crumpled receipt on the counter; terms of service flutter off it, unread

D18.picture: A puppet feeds arcade tokens into the teller's slot

D19.picture: Slow-motion crew walk, crates of bottles on their shoulders, split screen

D20.picture: A calendar flips to Monday; a shinier teller window opens next door

D21.picture: Half the line peels off to the new window in one move

D22.picture: Therapy session: the teller on a chaise, a puppet with a clipboard, tape spooling onto the floor

D23.picture: A faceless investigator in a trench coat holds a blurred printout up to camera; the puppets look at each other and shrug

D24.picture: A Polaroid pinned to a blank org-chart silhouette with red string; the string goes slack

D25.picture: A bottle pops its cork; its label becomes a screen showing a real Qwen 3.8 audit excerpt, verbatim from log/audits/, where it identifies itself as Claude, made by Anthropic. The crew shushes it. From "wait" through pre-chorus 2, a split screen of two real captures, model name visible in each: left, a bare chat asking "Who made you?" and getting "I'm Qwen…"; right, the audit prompt getting "I am Claude…". Caption: SAME MODEL. HANDED A PAGE ABOUT CLAUDE, IT DECIDED IT WAS CLAUDE. Then, smaller: Models often misidentify themselves. This is not evidence of distillation. (Clip with Real inserts. Absorbs D26, so the caption gets a full read: about 7.6 s, to chorus 2.)

D26.picture: Retired November 9, 2026: folded into D25, whose split screen now runs over "inherited traits". The family portrait is dropped

D27.picture: Reprise of D15–D19 with twice the puppets (pre-chorus 2 is under D25's split screen)

D27a.picture: Drum fill. The teller slides a typed scorecard out under its window; a puppet holds it up at arm's length

D28.picture: A mechanical counter slams into frame; a calendar page reads FEB

D31.picture: The crew crams crates into the proxy van from D05 until the back doors burst open. The counter shrinks to a corner and stays

D32.anchor: "Now the Feds put out a warning…"
D32.picture: Three grey-coat silhouettes under a streetlight, one holding a stapled memo with no seal

D33.picture: Behind a curtain, the Feds wheel away the brass teller and wheel in a plywood twin painted gold

D34.anchor: "So we're sippin' on a spiked batch…"
D34.picture: Tasting gag: puppets swirl, sip, and grimace in unison

D35.picture: Grey-gloved hands shuffle two identical bottles like a shell game

D36.picture: Needle-scratch freeze; slow pull back from the vault

D37.picture: X-ray of the vault walls: library books, forum printouts, blog pages

D38.picture: The probe, LED in a new color, wheelbarrows bundles of pages in at noon, waving to passersby

D39.anchor: "…'Stop, thief!' from a house of borrowed light"
D39.picture: The teller shouts from inside a house made of paper pages, lit from within

D39a.anchor: "Sure, a fake ID ain't a library card…"
D39a.picture: Even split screen: a puppet's forged ID refused at a counter; a library card stamping out an armful of books

D39b.picture: The paper house gets a gold stamp, TRANSFORMATIVE; the crew's crates get a red one, NATIONAL SECURITY

D39c.picture: An empty judge's bench (the Never Saw Her callback); the teller reaches for the gavel, then backs away

D39d.anchor: "…own a piece of what they've grown"
D39d.picture: Signatures surface across the vault's paper walls, each with a small IOU slip pinned beside it

D40.picture: A second crew, puppets in different colors, lines up at the first crew's bottle shop

D41.picture: A circular dolly shot: vault, crew, startup, vault, all passing bottles round

D42.picture: Everyone dancing at the still: crew, second crew, probe, teller

D42b.picture: The Feds alone in a corner, tapping their feet; one sneaks a sip from a bottle and freezes when the camera finds it

D42a.anchor: "Did we build the brain…? / Depends who's at the door"
D42a.picture: The music drops out; the vault door swings open on teller, crew and Feds, each pointing at someone else

D43.text: NO WEIGHTS WERE HARMED IN THE MAKING OF THIS SONG

D44.picture: One last stamp; the counter keeps ticking

D44a.anchor: "One crew denies it. The rest ain't talkin'."
D44a.picture: One puppet at a tiny podium shakes its head; the rest stand silent, facing camera

D44b.picture: The teller window flips its sign to OPEN; a ticket dispenser spits out the next number

D44c.picture: Pull back from the teller window along the line of puppets around the block (the D10 callback), the exchange counter still ticking in the corner; fade to black with the bass
